## core/ecs

| file | class | what it is |
|---|---|---|
| `component_names.gd` | ComponentNames | Named constants for component class-name lookups. Entity.get_component() keys on get_global_name() string output — a typo'd raw literal ("NCPData") fails silently (returns null, not an error). Centralizing the strings here means a typo is a compile-time unreso |
| `entity.gd` | Entity | Entity = id + a bag of data-contract components (NPCData, BuildingData, etc). No behavior lives here — systems read/write components, entities just hold them. |
| `spatial_index.gd` | SpatialIndex | Uniform grid spatial hash for proximity queries (player-NPC encounter detection, later crime-witness-radius checks) — O(entities in nearby cells) instead of O(all entities) per query. Zomboid precedent for the *shape* of this (confirmed): its world is partitio |
| `system_base.gd` | SystemBase | Base class every sim system extends. A system declares its tick_rate and implements process_entities — World calls it at the right cadence, the system never schedules itself. |
| `world.gd` | World | Orchestrator: owns all entities, runs systems at their declared tick_rate. step() is called by a driver (Godot _physics_process, or a headless test loop) — World itself never touches the scene tree, keeping it testable and deterministic independent of frame ra |
